## Q3 Planning sync — 2026-08-27

### Key points

- Reconciliation engine rewrite is the Q3 anchor. Build chosen over buy: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K/yr, no jurisdiction-specific tax code support) would each still need ~3 engineer-weeks of integration. Rewrite is ~6 engineer-weeks including the FX rounding module migration, and needs Karim (platform) for 2 weeks on ledger integration.
- Rewrite is justified by three multi-currency incidents this quarter and a 40% QoQ rise in reconciliation support tickets.
- Mobile receipt-capture v1 ships without bulk-select. Bulk-select (about a sprint of work) goes on the roadmap as a fast-follow. The OCR confidence indicator must be made far more prominent based on testing with six users.
- Vendor payout SLA: finance wants 48h p95 from invoice approval; current p95 is 71h. Proposed fix is cutting the ACH batch window from 12h to 4h (eng, ~half a sprint plus SRE sign-off) and adding a second west-coast-shift approver (ops), targeting 48h p95 by mid-Q3. Not yet approved: it goes ahead only if SRE deems the added monitoring load manageable; otherwise the team looks at intermediate targets.
- Audit-log retention update is pushed to Q4, confirmed with Legal.
- Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew, no change.
- HR flagged a spike in bug-bash burnout on engineering; a rotating on-call structure proposal was requested.
- Q3 scope locks Friday; scope draft circulates Thursday morning; Sara presents at exec review Monday.

### Action items

- Marcus: sync with Karim's manager and confirm Karim's two-week availability for the reconciliation rewrite, by end of this week.
- Marcus (with Jenna): complete the ACH batch-window trade-off analysis including SRE sign-off on monitoring load, and bring it back next week.
- Marcus: propose a rotating on-call structure, by August 31.
- Dan: update the mobile receipt-capture specs to remove bulk-select from v1 and make the OCR confidence indicator more prominent, by Wednesday.
- Jenna: pair with Marcus on the ACH trade-off analysis, for next week.
- Priya: add reconciliation as the Q3 anchor and add the bulk-select fast-follow to the roadmap; circulate the Q3 scope draft Thursday morning ahead of Friday lock.
- Sara: present Q3 scope at exec review, Monday.
